text: This S1000D data module documents the controls and indicators of a mountain bicycle. It provides descriptions and functions of key bicycle components including the LED taillight, chrome bell, LED headlight, and platform pedals, accompanied by an illustrative figure. The module is classified as a technical reference document, issued in English (US) on July 16, 2026, with standard copyright and export restrictions from ASD.

This S1000D document is a fault isolation procedure for front wheel tire malfunctions on mountain bicycles (Mountain Storm Mk1 or Brook Trekker Mk9). It provides a diagnostic decision tree guiding technicians to identify tire issues—checking pressure readings and physical damage—and directing them to appropriate corrective actions: deflating, inflating, or replacing the tire or inner tube. The document includes required tools and references related maintenance procedures.

This S1000D data module is a functional item numbers common information repository for lighting systems on mountain bicycles (specifically Mountain Storm Mk1 and Brook Trekker Mk9 models). It documents and catalogues all functional items—including front/rear lights, battery, electronic box, generator, relay, switches, and connectors—with their identification numbers, installation locations, and applicability to specific product variants. This repository serves as a shared reference for technical documentation.

This S1000D data module documents a common information repository for lighting system access panels and doors, specifically for mountain bicycles (Mountain storm Mk1 or Brook trekker Mk9). It defines access point specifications and types, including a dummy access point providing access to electrical components. The document includes copyright, export controls, and applicability information managed by the Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe.

# Document Description

This S1000D data module documents wiring equipment lists for a lighting system (issue 012, dated July 2026). It specifies electrical components used in bicycle wiring, including lights, battery, generator, switches, relay, distribution module, and connectors with their part numbers, installation locations on the bike frame/handlebars, and connection classifications. The document includes recent additions of strobe module and strobe switch components, along with copyright, security, and distribution restrictions from the Aerospace, Security and Defence Industries Association of Europe.

This is a Data Management List (DML) document that catalogs and indexes technical documentation for mountain bicycles and brake systems. Issued July 16, 2026 by the AEROSPACE, SECURITY AND DEFENCE INDUSTRIES ASSOCIATION OF EUROPE, it contains metadata references to multiple data modules covering bicycle components, maintenance procedures, applicability tables, and administrative repositories. The document specifies security classifications, export controls, and distribution restrictions for technical publications conforming to S1000D standards.
